## Problem

What workflow is difficult or impossible today? Describe the outcome you want,
not only an implementation idea.

## Proposed behavior

What should `hyprwake` do? Include an example command, configuration, or
restore scenario when helpful.

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds or related tools have you tried?

## Additional context

For a reproducible malfunction, please open a bug report instead. Do not post
snapshots, raw logs, command-line arguments, or other private desktop state.
